name: Exercise — 3 Days (Standard)
description: Standard three-day exercise template covering preparation, execution, and evaluation. Suitable for multi-team command post exercises and operational drills with full planning and AAR cycle.

groups.name: Control Cell (EXCON)
groups.description: Exercise control, administration, and inject management

items.title: Day 1 — Opening Brief & Scenario Overview
items.description: EXCON delivers full scenario overview, rules of engagement, and exercise objectives.

items.title: Day 1 — Team Planning Phase
items.description: Teams conduct initial planning and establish command structures.

items.title: INITEX — Exercise Commences
items.description: Exercise formally begins. All teams report readiness.

items.title: Day 1 — INJECT #1 (Initial Incident)
items.description: First scenario inject. Opening event that sets the exercise in motion.

items.title: Day 1 — Initial Response
items.description: Teams respond to opening inject. Document actions, communications, and decisions.

items.title: Day 1 — Evening Hot Wash
items.description: Brief end-of-day review. Key observations, issues to address overnight.

items.title: Day 2 — Morning Situation Update
items.description: Updated SITREP. Overnight developments briefed to all participants.

items.title: Day 2 — INJECT #2 (Escalation)
items.description: Major escalation inject. Raises complexity and stress on teams.

items.title: Day 2 — Critical Decision Point
items.description: Teams must make a high-stakes decision within 30 minutes.

items.title: Day 2 — Multi-Team Coordination
items.description: Alpha and Bravo teams coordinate response to escalated situation.

items.title: Day 2 — INJECT #3 (Complication)
items.description: Additional complicating factor introduced to test team flexibility.

items.title: Day 2 — Observer Assessment Period
items.description: Observers conduct structured evaluation of team performance.

items.title: Day 3 — Culminating Event
items.description: Final complex inject requiring full team integration and peak performance.

items.title: Day 3 — Resolution & Recovery
items.description: Teams bring situation to resolution. Document final status.

items.title: ENDEX — Exercise Ends
items.description: Exercise formally concluded. All activity ceases.

items.title: Day 3 — After Action Review (AAR)
items.description: Full structured AAR. Facilitator reviews timeline, key decisions, lessons identified.

items.title: Day 3 — Closing Remarks & Admin Out
items.description: Closing remarks, certificates, equipment return, debrief.
